blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — AboitizPower recently renewed its partnership with the Inquirer Foundation for its journalism scholarship program, which represents both organizations’ continued joint effort to support the future of Philippine media. At the signing, Inquirer Group of Companies President and CEO Sandy Prieto-Romualdez addressed the young student beneficiaries — both old and new — and offered profound advice for journalists. Sandy urged the scholars to be resilient to the point of being stubborn in the service of journalism, as it is a noble form of public service.
